Summary
: The Narada Purana (Nārada Purāṇa) is one of the major eighteen Mahapuranas, a genre of Hindu religious texts. It deals with the places of pilgrimages and features a dialogue between the sage Narada, and Sanatkumara. 
During the course of the dialogue between the two, Narada explains to Sanatkumara the major places of piligrimages, their location, and significance.
